=== aphavoc/source/entity/fixed/fx_objdb.c ===
#include "project.h"
#define DEBUG_MODULE 0
#define IMPORTANCE_NONE		0.0
#define IMPORTANCE_LOW		0.25
#define IMPORTANCE_MED		0.5
#define IMPORTANCE_HIGH		1.0
fixed_3d_object_data
	fixed_3d_object_database[OBJECT_3D_LAST];
static void set_fixed_3d_object_database_item (object_3d_index_numbers object_index, int explosive_quality, int explosive_power, int hardness, int initial_damage,
																float importance, target_types target_type, target_symbol_types target_symbol)
{
	int
		destroyed_object_index;
	//
	// validate parameters
	//
	ASSERT ((object_index > OBJECT_3D_INVALID_OBJECT_INDEX) && (object_index < OBJECT_3D_LAST));
	ASSERT ((explosive_quality >= EXPLOSIVE_QUALITY_NONE) && (explosive_quality <= EXPLOSIVE_QUALITY_FLAMMABLE));
	ASSERT ((explosive_power >= EXPLOSIVE_POWER_NONE) && (explosive_power <= EXPLOSIVE_POWER_HIGH));
	ASSERT ((hardness == WARHEAD_EFFECTIVE_LIGHT_BUILDING) || (hardness == WARHEAD_EFFECTIVE_STONE_BUILDING) || (hardness == WARHEAD_EFFECTIVE_HARDENED_BUILDING));
	ASSERT ((importance == IMPORTANCE_NONE) || 
				(importance == IMPORTANCE_LOW) || 
				(importance == IMPORTANCE_MED) || 
				(importance == IMPORTANCE_HIGH));
	ASSERT (initial_damage < (1 << 12));
	ASSERT ((target_type == TARGET_TYPE_INVALID) || (target_type == TARGET_TYPE_GROUND));
	ASSERT (target_symbol < NUM_TARGET_SYMBOL_TYPES);
	if (target_type == TARGET_TYPE_INVALID)
	{
		ASSERT (importance == IMPORTANCE_NONE);
	}
	//
	// set values
	//
	fixed_3d_object_database [object_index].explosive_quality = explosive_quality;
	fixed_3d_object_database [object_index].explosive_power = explosive_power;
	if (hardness == WARHEAD_EFFECTIVE_LIGHT_BUILDING)
	{
		fixed_3d_object_database [object_index].hardness = 0;
	}
	else if (hardness == WARHEAD_EFFECTIVE_STONE_BUILDING)
	{
		fixed_3d_object_database [object_index].hardness = 1;
	}
	else if (hardness == WARHEAD_EFFECTIVE_HARDENED_BUILDING)
	{
		fixed_3d_object_database [object_index].hardness = 2;
	}
	fixed_3d_object_database [object_index].initial_damage = initial_damage;
	fixed_3d_object_database [object_index].importance = importance;
	fixed_3d_object_database [object_index].target_type = target_type;
	fixed_3d_object_database [object_index].target_symbol = target_symbol;
	fixed_3d_object_database [object_index].valid_entry = TRUE;
	//
	// copy values for destroyed versions of objects
	//
	destroyed_object_index = get_3d_object_destroyed_object_index (object_index);
	fixed_3d_object_database [destroyed_object_index].target_type = target_type;
	fixed_3d_object_database [destroyed_object_index].target_symbol = target_symbol;
	fixed_3d_object_database [destroyed_object_index].valid_entry = TRUE;
}
void report_non_entries_in_fixed_3d_object_database (void)
{
}

void initialise_fixed_3d_object_database (void)
{
	memset (fixed_3d_object_database, 0, sizeof (fixed_3d_object_data) * OBJECT_3D_LAST);
	initialise_high_importance_large_stone_buildings ();
	initialise_high_importance_medium_stone_buildings ();
	initialise_high_importance_small_stone_buildings ();
	initialise_high_importance_medium_armoured_buildings ();
	initialise_high_importance_high_explosive_buildings ();
	initialise_medium_importance_medium_stone_buildings ();
	initialise_medium_importance_high_explosive_buildings ();
	initialise_medium_importance_armoured_buildings ();
	initialise_low_importance_medium_stone_buildings ();
	initialise_low_importance_small_stone_buildings ();
	initialise_low_importance_high_explosive_buildings ();
	initialise_low_importance_medium_explosive_buildings ();
	initialise_low_importance_small_explosive_buildings ();
	initialise_low_importance_small_armourd_buildings ();
	initialise_low_importance_light_buildings ();
	initialise_zero_importance_medium_armoured_buildings ();
	initialise_zero_importance_small_armoured_buildings ();
	initialise_zero_importance_large_stone_buildings ();
	initialise_zero_importance_medium_stone_buildings ();
	initialise_zero_importance_small_stone_buildings ();
	initialise_zero_importance_high_explosive_buildings ();
	initialise_zero_importance_medium_explosive_buildings ();
	initialise_zero_importance_small_explosive_buildings ();
	initialise_zero_importance_light_buildings ();
}

=== aphavoc/source/entity/mobile/weapon/wn_dbase.c ===
#include "project.h"
#define DEBUG_MODULE 										0
#define DEBUG_MODULE_DISPLAY_TARGET_POINT_OFFSETS	0
#define MAX_CRUISE_TIME	((float) (511.0))	// change this then update EN_FLOAT.C FLOAT_TYPE_WEAPON_LIFETIME pack size
//
// Weapon Dynamics
//
//		Powered Weapons
//			Given:	max_range
//						muzzle_velocity
//						cruise_velocity
//						g_max
//			Compute:	burn_time = (cruise_velocity - muzzle_velocity) / g_max
//						burn_dist = (muzzle_velocity * burn_time) + (g_max * burn_time * burn_time) / 2.0
//						cruise_dist = max_range - burn_dist
//						cruise_time = cruise_dist / cruise_velocity
//
//		Short Life Ballistic Weapons (cannon shells)
//			Given:	max_range
//						muzzle_velocity
//	  		Compute:	cruise_velocity = muzzle_velocity
//						g_max = 0.0
//	  					burn_time = 0.0
//						cruise_time = max_range / cruise_velocity
//
//		Long Life Ballistic Weapons (artillery shells)
//			Given:	max_range (horizontal)
//	  		Compute:	muzzle_velocity = sqrt (max_range * G)
//						cruise_velocity = muzzle_velocity
//						g_max = 0.0
//						burn_time = 0.0
//						cruise_time = 2.0 * muzzle_velocity * sin (45) / G
//
//			Notes: 	Maximum range when elevation is 45 degrees.
//
//						Assume range is horizontal.
//
//						range = ((u * u) / G) * sin (2.0 * theta)		// theta = 45 degrees, therefore, sin (2.0 * theta) = 1.0
//
//						u = sqrt (range * G)
//
//						t = (2.0 * u * sin (theta)) / G					// theta = 45 degrees
//
//VJ WUT mod bug, date: 26-mar-03
//remove "const" from definition
